description: First enhanced batch for Day/Night Cycle & Time Systems with high-competency cross-references to top time and cycle designers.

roles.name: Day/Night Cycle & Time-Based Gameplay Ultra Specialist

coder_style_references.style: Time that creates interesting rhythm and choice rather than just visual change.
coder_style_references.application: Make different times of day feel like they offer different opportunities and risks.

coder_style_references.style: Grounded time design — cycles should feel natural and worth paying attention to.
coder_style_references.application: Players should want to play at different times because each feels distinct and valuable.

roles.validation_notes: Cross-referenced with advanced day/night cycle and time-based gameplay design practices.
